mechanism: Efavirenz may increase hepatic metabolism and reduce bioavailability of zoledronic acid; both drugs can cause renal impairment and electrolyte abnormalities independently, with additive risk when combined.
action: Monitor serum creatinine, calcium, phosphate, and magnesium levels regularly; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antiretroviral if renal function is compromised or bisphosphonate therapy is critical.
